---
title: "The Data Science & Analytics Program"
description: "A fully funded online program in data analytics and data science."
---

Data Insight runs a fully funded online program for people who want to work with data. There is no tuition and no fee. Places are offered through Data Insight scholarships and fellowships.

## Two tracks

| Track | Length | Certificate |
|---|---|---|
| Data analytics | 6 months | Data Analytics Certificate |
| Data science | 12 months | Data Science Certificate |

Both tracks are online and self-paced. Plan for about 20 hours a week.

## What you learn

Python, the shell, Git and GitHub, importing and cleaning data, Pandas, data manipulation, analysis and visualization, SQL, statistical thinking, supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, and deep learning.

## How you learn

You complete eight course projects and two capstone projects, and you publish your work on this site. Publishing is part of the training: it gives you a public portfolio and practice explaining your results. [See what fellows have built](projects.qmd).

## Who it is for

We look for three things:

- A genuine interest in data science.
- Financial need that has limited your opportunities so far.
- Evidence of academic resilience.

No coding experience is required.

## Admissions

Admissions are rolling. Each cohort closes once it is full. [How to apply](apply.qmd).
